description: Rebrand the product display name from cam-cli to CAM Runtime (uppercase splash + strings + docs); the cam command and all behavior-affecting names stay unchanged.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Ink's <Text color> prop accepts named colors, hex strings (e.g. #005cc5), and rgb() via chalk under the hood. Confirms the Fir Green #10C66F hex accent is valid for the splash wordmark/divider with no API change.

userStories.title: Uppercase CAM wordmark + Runtime line + Fir Green accent in the splash

acceptanceCriteria: src/ui/Splash.tsx WORDMARK_ROWS are re-authored as NEW uppercase 'CAM' ASCII block glyphs (not upcased letters of the old lowercase 'cam'), and a styled 'Runtime' text line renders below the wordmark. [oracle: grep -q 'Runtime' src/ui/Splash.tsx]

The splash accent (wordmark blocks + panel divider/highlight) uses Fir Green #10C66F sourced via the design tokens path (brandGreens.firGreen in src/design/tokens.ts), not a hardcoded stray hex. [oracle: grep -q 'brandGreens\|firGreen' src/ui/Splash.tsx]

The splash still renders correctly (bordered panel, wordmark rows, tagline, version+url line) via ink-testing-library; verified by rendering the real component and inspecting output, not header comments. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Verify the screen renders correctly (ink-testing-library render of Splash; success is shown by the ✓/✗ glyph, never divider color). [oracle: bun test]

userStories.notes: Files: src/ui/Splash.tsx (WORDMARK_ROWS:27-33 hand-authored ASCII, WordmarkRow, Splash). Import the accent from src/design/tokens.ts brandGreens.firGreen (#10C66F, CAM-332 brand primary) rather than a new literal; the current splash colors block/shade via colors.accent (theme.ts -> palette.accent #4EBE7D). Ink <Text color> accepts hex (confirmed via Ink docs, officialDocsConsulted). The lowercase wordmark spells 'cam' (NOT 'cam-cli'): uppercasing means authoring brand-new block rows for C/A/M, keeping every row the same width so panel centering stays even. Splash renders ONLY from cam init (src/commands/init.ts:341). No test asserts the wordmark today, so it is test-safe. Ink invariant: success/failure is the ✓/✗ glyph, never divider color; render the real component and look at output (patterns.md, lessons.archive 2026-06-05). Splash is under src/ui, not templates/vendor: no embed-vendor needed.

userStories.notes: Files: package.json (name 'cam-cli' -> 'cam-runtime', :2), README.md (title '# cam-cli' :1 + product description lines; positioning source of truth: 'CAM Runtime is a local software-delivery runtime for coding agents. It turns issues and goals into verifiable planning, implementation, review, and ship workflows, keeping state, coordinating specialized agents, and recovering interrupted runs.'), CHANGELOG.md (title/product line, do NOT rewrite history).
